description: Lists recent agent runs with status and policy result. Filter by outcome (approved/denied/escalated) to audit activity or find run IDs for receipt lookup.

limit.description: Number of runs to return. Maximum 50, default 20.

outcome.description: Filter runs by policy outcome. Use 'denied' to audit blocked actions.

since.description: ISO 8601 date string. Return only runs after this timestamp.

name: yax_list_runs

runs.description: Array of run summary objects, each with run_id, status, policy result, and receipt CIDs.

total.description: Total number of runs matching the filter.
